notifier.title: Never miss a post again.
notifier.text: Niko watches your favourite creators and posts their new videos, streams and updates straight into a channel you choose.
notifier.introText: Add an account once, then point each one at its own channel, role ping or custom message.
notifier.disabledNotice: Announcements are switched off for this server. Every account below is paused until you re-enable them.
notifier.defaultsDetail: Choose where new accounts post and who gets pinged when you do not set that per account.
notifier.defaultChannelHint: Used when an account has no channel of its own.
notifier.quietHint: Leave empty for a quiet announcement.
notifier.autopostHint: Turn this off to pause every announcement without removing your accounts
notifier.addDetail: Paste a profile link or type the account name — Niko checks it against the platform before saving.
notifier.accountHint: A profile link is fine too.
notifier.channelRequiredHint: This server has no default channel yet, so pick where announcements should go.
notifier.channelHint: Optional — leave it on the default channel (#{channel}) or pick another.
notifier.capacityHint: Adding the same account again updates its channel, ping role and message.
notifier.capacityLine: {platform} of {platformMax} used on this platform · {total} of {max} total
notifier.validatesLive: Niko validates the account live, so this can take a second.
notifier.followedDetail: Each account keeps its own channel, ping role and message, and can be paused without losing its history.
notifier.empty: Nothing is being tracked yet. Add your first account above and Niko will start announcing it.
notifier.noData: This server has no notification data yet.
notifier.loadFailed: Social notifications could not be loaded.
notifier.limitGuild: This server already follows {count} accounts. Remove one before adding another.
notifier.limitPlatform: This server already follows {count} {platform} accounts. Remove one before adding another.
notifier.platformsUnavailable: The notifier platforms are unavailable right now. Reload the dashboard in a moment.
notifier.settingsSaved: Notification settings saved for this server.
notifier.settingsSaveFailed: Notification settings could not be saved.
notifier.pickPlatform: Pick the platform you want to follow.
notifier.pickChannel: Pick the channel announcements should go to.
notifier.accountAdded: Account added. New posts will be announced now.
notifier.accountUpdated: That account was already followed, so its settings were updated.
notifier.addFailed: That account could not be added.
notifier.pickAccountChannel: Pick a channel for that account.
notifier.nothingToSave: Nothing to save for that account.
notifier.updateFailed: That account could not be updated.
notifier.testFailed: The test notification could not be sent.
notifier.removeFailed: That account could not be removed.
